exposure: Duration of active first stage of labour (<6h, 6-<12h, >=12h)
Duration of active second stage of labour (<1h, >=1h)
outcome: 24-hour perinatal outcome (intrapartum stillbirth, newborn death, admission to Neonatal Unit)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 12,481 singleton, non-caesarean, non-antepartum stillbirth deliveries with complete time variables at Haydom Lutheran Hospital in rural Tanzania between March 2013 and November 2018.
finding: A second stage of labour lasting 1 hour or more was significantly associated with an adverse 24-hour perinatal outcome (OR 3.38, 95% CI 1.95-5.88), while the duration of the first stage was not significantly related to the outcome.
